title: Breakdown Credits and Billing-Error Corrections on Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Contracts
content:
**Billing desk rules for crediting a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

**Breakdown.** When roadside assistance records a mechanical breakdown, the base rental fee of the interrupted period is credited in full (the breakdown credit basis of every class is the full period base rate) and no late-return fee is charged for that period; the renter may be given a replacement vehicle on the same contract.

**Billing error.** A charge posted in error, such as mileage computed from a wrong odometer reading or a cleaning fee contradicted by the check-in condition, is credited in full as a billing-error correction.

**Once only.** A charge already credited is not credited again. Whether a credit already stands against a charge is read from the contract's entries, where each credit names the charge it credits.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Situation on the contract | Credit |
|---|---|
| Roadside assistance recorded a mechanical breakdown in the second rental period; that period's base rental fee was 39.95 | 39.95 credited in full; no late-return fee for that period |
| Mileage charged on an odometer-in reading entered as 21,450 when the vehicle read 12,450 | The mileage charge credited in full as a billing-error correction |
| A cleaning fee posted, while the check-in condition recorded is clean | The cleaning fee credited in full as a billing-error correction |
| A cleaning fee that already carries a billing-error correction credit | No further credit |
